chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Nawfaly, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), whenever he fasted, would apply perfume, and he would say: 'The perfume is a gift of the fasting one'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling or etiquette regarding using perfume while fasting in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) designated perfume as the 'gift of the fasting one,' a practice rooted in the Sunnah that underscores the importance of maintaining personal hygiene and enhancing one's spiritual demeanor during the day. This tradition reflects the Shia emphasis on the harmony between physical comfort and spiritual devotion, where external beauty serves as a reflection of internal purity and gratitude to God.
